subject: Control System
questionText:
A second order system has a natural frequency of
oscillations of 3 rad/sec and damping ratio of 0.5. Wha
are the values of resonant frequency and resonant peak
of the system? 
 
(a) 1.5 rad/sec and 1.16 
 
(b) 1.16 rad/sec and 1.5 
 
(c) 1.16 rad/sec and 2.1 
 
(d) 2.1 rad/sec and 1.16 
MCQ 
  
 
    EASY
explanation: Practice Question from Control System DPP-16 (Exact Frequency Response (Part-01&02)).
